info.title: Straits.live premium data
info.description: Machine-payable Strait of Hormuz crisis data for AI agents: the live-AIS vessel manifest, single-vessel multi-body sanctions dossiers (OFAC + UK), a shadow-fleet risk screen of the vessels active on AIS in the Persian Gulf window, a flag rollup, bunker & marine-fuel prices, a modeled war-risk transit premium nowcast, full-resolution history, bulk export, a one-call situation snapshot, the complete daily brief, real-time streaming, and threshold-alert webhooks. Settled per request in USDC on Base over the x402 protocol; no key, no account.
info.x-guidance: Fourteen operations: twelve priced per request ($0.01-$0.50), plus two free ones (GET /api/premium/stream, which a session token authenticates, and DELETE /api/premium/webhooks/{id}, which the subscription secret authenticates). Most are GET; POST /api/premium/stream/session and POST /api/premium/webhooks take a JSON body. An unpaid request returns HTTP 402 with a machine-readable x402 challenge; sign the USDC authorization and retry (x402-capable clients such as @x402/fetch handle this automatically). Every route except the stream is rate limited to 30 requests per 60 seconds per client IP, one sliding window shared across all of them. Start with GET /api/premium/snapshot for the whole dashboard state in one call. GET /api/premium/history/{feed} serves full-resolution time series (feeds: index-5min, transits, stranded, ais-gaps); GET /api/premium/export bundles every series in one archive. GET /api/premium/vessel/{imo} returns one vessel dossier; GET /api/premium/hormuz/risk-screen ranks the whole live vessel population worst-first with per-hull risk reasons and sanctions matches; GET /api/premium/hormuz/flags rolls it up by flag state; GET /api/premium/bunker returns current bunker & marine-fuel prices with the Fujairah premium over Singapore and Rotterdam; GET /api/premium/risk-premium returns a live modeled war-risk transit premium (Nx over the peace baseline, 1x-80x scale) with the standing straits.live insurance-estimate multiple as a static reference. Ten of these products are also exposed as paid MCP tools at https://straits.live/api/mcp. A free tier lives at https://straits.live/status and /api/v1/* with summary counts and shorter history windows on some series; human documentation, including an exact free-vs-premium comparison, at https://straits.live/api.

get.summary: Historical series: stranded and AIS-gap counts (hourly buckets with gaps, capped at one year, growing), 5-min index (7 days a page, pageable with before), daily transits

parameters.name: feed
parameters.description: index-5min: both Hormuz indices at every tick (10 minutes apart since 2026-11-03 12:32Z, 5 before), pages of 7 days at most (a larger days value is cut to 7), page back with before to reach the full history. transits: complete daily IMF PortWatch history, enriched per day with the 7-day moving average, pre-crisis-baseline deviation, and reopening-threshold headroom. stranded: hourly stranded-vessel counts, up to a year. ais-gaps: hourly AIS-dark counts, up to a year.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: index-5min only: window in days, 1-7 (default 7). A larger value is cut to 7; page back with before.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: index-5min only: ISO-8601 date or timestamp ending the window, exclusive (default now). Pass the previous response nextBefore to page back through the full tick history. An invalid value returns 400 and is not charged.

200.description: Historical series; the body varies by feed

truncated.description: True when the read hit its ceiling, so older rows exist that this call did not return. Always false for index-5min, which reads only the requested window.

expectedHours.description: stranded and ais-gaps only: hours from the first to the last returned point, inclusive

missingHours.description: stranded and ais-gaps only: expectedHours minus the points returned

droppedPartialBuckets.description: stranded only: partial-census buckets removed from the series

completenessNote.description: stranded and ais-gaps only: how to read the gaps. truncated refers only to the retention cap.

days.description: index-5min only: the window actually served, 1-7. Smaller than the days you asked for when the request was cut to 7.

crisisPressure.description: index-5min only: Crisis Pressure series, one point per tick

escalationForecast.description: index-5min only: Escalation Forecast series, one point per tick

points.description: transits, stranded and ais-gaps only; index-5min carries crisisPressure and escalationForecast instead. transits rows add ma7, baselineDelta and thresholdHeadroom to each PortWatch day; stranded rows are hourly total/anchored/stopped/transit/stranded.

baseline.description: transits only: the frozen pre-crisis daily baseline

reopeningThreshold.description: transits only: the 7-day-MA level the reopening markets resolve on

resolution.description: transits: object, the distance-to-resolution outlook. index-5min: the string "5min", the sampling of crisisPressure and escalationForecast.

window.description: index-5min only: the window served, { from, to, days, maxDays, clamped, requestedDays }. clamped is true when your days value was cut to maxDays (7); requestedDays then holds what you sent.

olderAvailable.description: index-5min only: true when ticks older than window.from exist; page back with before=nextBefore

oldestTick.description: index-5min only: timestamp of the oldest stored tick

nextBefore.description: index-5min only: the earliest timestamp returned; pass it as before for the next older page. Null when no older ticks exist (olderAvailable is false).

note.description: index-5min, stranded and ais-gaps: how to read the series, including how to page

basis.description: stranded only: how the counts were measured after basisChangedAt

basisChangedAt.description: stranded only: date of the latest series break. Do not difference across it. The latest (2026-09-26) moved vessels with an hour-old AIS fix out of the counts, stepping stranded down about 30%; the one before (2026-07-30) stepped counts up about 3.4x on total.

402.description: Payment Required. The signed x402 challenge is in the base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header; the JSON body is informational.

PAYMENT-REQUIRED.description: Base64 x402 v2 challenge: accepts[] entries of scheme, network, amount, asset, payTo.

price.description: Decimal USD with a leading $, e.g. "$0.02"

network.description: CAIP-2 chain id, e.g. eip155:8453 for Base

404.description: Unknown feed (not charged). Body carries the valid feeds[] list.

429.description: Rate limited: 30 requests per 60 seconds per client IP, one sliding window shared across all /api/premium/* routes. Retry-After, X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset are set.

get.summary: Bulk history export: stranded and ais-gaps cap at 365 days; transits is full history; index-5min is every tick for the last 7 days and daily before that

parameters.name: feeds
parameters.description: Comma-separated subset of index-5min, stranded, ais-gaps, transits; omit for all. The index-5min series holds 7 days of tick points (10 minutes apart since 2026-11-03) (crisisPressure, escalationForecast) plus daily open/close/min/max/mean/band rows (crisisPressureDaily, escalationForecastDaily) from the daily rollup, and states its resolution, window and paging route in its resolution, window and note fields. Older 5-minute ticks: /api/premium/history/index-5min?before=.

get.summary: War-risk transit premium nowcast: a live modeled war-risk insurance multiple (Nx over the peace baseline, 1x-80x scale) for the strait, recomputed every 10 minutes from weekly IMF PortWatch throughput (can run more than a week behind), escalation, OVX, and event signals, with the standing straits.live insurance-estimate multiple carried as a static reference

200.description: Live modeled war-risk premium with drivers, a static insurance-estimate reference, and confidence

modeledMultiple.description: Live modeled war-risk multiple, 1x (peace) to 80x (top of the published curve). The headline figure.

confidence.description: 0-1; degrades when driver feeds are stale/missing or escalation-market volume is thin

reference.description: Static context: straitsEstimateMultiple (the standing straits.live insurance-estimate multiple, manually set and infrequently changed; not a Joint War Committee figure), asOf, source, and a note. jwcMultiple carries the same value for compatibility and is deprecated (see reference.deprecated). NOT a live comparator.

vlccWarPremiumUsd.description: VLCC war-premium band (low/high USD per voyage): the curated market-reported range, estimated separately from modeledMultiple, so the two will not divide exactly

drivers.description: Per-driver score, raw value, health, and weight: throughput, escalation, ovx, event

degraded.description: Drivers that were stale or missing and dropped out of the estimate
